answers.core: A small modification to the functionality of a core node doesn't merit an add-on.
answers.workaround:
There are some hacky workarounds involving the use of [child nodes](https://youtu.be/R7N2ew2rezA), but these have their own limitations and annoyances. 

Given that this is a very minor tweak that would improve workflow considerably for certain use-cases, I feel it's fair to add this to the engine.
